newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech komercni surges on foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: Czech komercni surges on foreign demand.

text.p: Shares in the largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s. surged on the Prague bourse on Wednesday led by increasingly optimistic foreign sentiment about the banks's first half results, dealers said.
Komercni was up 108 crowns, six percent, just after mid-session to 1,895.

Last week, Komercni posted sharpy lower first half net profits. Many local dealers and anlysts received the results with alarm but Dan Gladis of Atlantik Financial Markets said foreigners were beginning to take a more optimistic view.

"People look at the figures and realise that the earnings that Komercni reported was actually not bad...The main reason why the earnings were down was due to huge unrealised loss on their securities holdings," Gladis said .
"But by the end of this year most of this money will be back because bonds are going up and equities are going up as well," he added.
